compounds.quote: * **butanoic acid: 635.2 mg/kg** – both packagings same at T0
compounds.name: butanoic acid

ammonia.reason: Low NH3 from limited deamination; no surface flora, moderate proteolysis only.

animal_barnyard.reason: Very low p-cresol/indole; housed/pasture cow milk without washed-rind flora.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from chymosin and LAB peptidases during 6-mo proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; no methyl ketone blue pathway.

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard from residual galactose/lactose plus amino acids on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by starter Lactococcus/Lactobacillus.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic acid 635.2 mg/kg plus 3-methylbutanoic 25 mg/kg from lipolysis and Leu catabolism.

creaminess.reason: Moderate fat 28.6% emulsion and 31% moisture gives smooth but not soft mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Cooked pressed low-moisture matrix with calcium phosphate loss creates short fracture.

firmness.reason: Low moisture 31.17% plus cooking 40-45C, pressing and 6-mo drying firms para-casein.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from Phe transamination by LAB.

fruity.reason: Low ethyl esters from ethanol plus free fatty acids; hexanoic only 5.0 mg/kg.

goaty.reason: Very low C6-C8 acids: hexanoic 5.0 mg/kg, octanoic 0.09 mg/kg, cow milk low in goaty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2/3-methylbutanal and propionibacteria notes from cooked alpine make.

melt.reason: Rennet curd pH 5.52 with solubilized colloidal calcium flows on heating, not acid-set.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic oxidation; no mushroom mold flora.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil from 28.6-35% fat coalescence on melting in aged matrix.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make; no guaiacol/syringol from wood smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic and acetic acids from starter fermentation, pH 5.52, moderate acid taste.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading; no aligned para-casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low H2S/methional from Met catabolism; mild cooked-curd note from 40-45C heating.

sweet.reason: Low lactose but glycerol/proline and diacetyl balance give sweet alpine perception.

umami.reason: Glutamate release from 6-mo proteolysis 27-29% protein enhances savory broth.
